title: ATD, the ADP Tool Language, 0.1
description: The JSON forms of ATD (ATD-specification.md, Appendix A): the abstract tree of a tool description (`Tree`), findings, parse tables, traces, conformance fixtures, drawings, capability contracts and their fixtures, and the walk. A tool description itself is text, `.atd`, whose grammar is in `grammar/`; its tree is not an interchange form.

Span.description: Where a node stands in its file: UTF-8 byte offsets of its first byte and of the byte after it, and the 1-based line and column of its start and end, columns in code points (ATD §3.1, §15).

Name.description: A name as written, with where it stands: a NAME or a keyword in a name position (ATD §3.6).

TypeRef.description: A type: a qualified name with its type arguments (`list<Concept>`).

Value.description: A value (ATD §6): exactly one of a literal, a CEL expression with its abstract syntax, a reference to an attribute, a theme token or a parameter, a settings map, or a list.

oneOf.description: A literal: a bare word, a number, a string or a length.
`@path`: an attribute of the current element, two-way where the position allows.
`#name`: a parameter of the enclosing shape, marker or template.
`{ key: value … }`: a settings map, in written order.

Setting.description: One `key: value` pair (ATD §6.4); `quoted` when the key was written as a string.

CelNode.description: CEL's abstract syntax (ATD §6.3), with spans: an operator is a call of its CEL function name (`_+_`, `_&&_`, `!_`, `-_`, `_?_:_`, `_[_]`, `@in`, `_[?_]`, `_?._`), a macro is a call marked `macro`, a method call has a `target`.

oneOf.description: An identifier; `root` when written with a leading dot.
A call of a function, an operator or a macro.
A list literal; `optional` names the indexes written with `?`.

items.description: An entry.

Tree.description: The abstract tree of one `.atd` file, as `atd tree` prints it (ATD §4.5, FR-030). It is not an interchange form: nothing reads it back as a description.

Tool.description: The tool construct of a root file (ATD §5.1).

Finding.description: A finding of the checker, a language server or validation (ATD §15, FR-091).

items.description: Another place the finding concerns.
A fix: text edits, in byte offsets, that resolve the finding.
One splice.

Findings.description: The findings of one run, in a stable order: by file, then position, then code (ATD §15.4). A refused file of the corpus states those it must give in this form; `message` is then not compared.

ParseTables.description: The LALR(1) automaton of a grammar in ATD grammar notation, normalized so that two implementations can be compared byte for byte (ATD §4.7): terminals by name (an anonymous string terminal is named by its quoted string), the rules of the grammar after the expansion of §4.4 sorted and numbered (a helper of a repetition named `(<symbols>)+`), and the states numbered breadth first from the start state over the symbols in sorted order, each with its actions on terminals (`s<state>`, `r<rule>`, `accept`) and its gotos on nonterminals.

items.description: A terminal.
A rule.
A state.

Trace.description: The trace of a tool description (ATD §2.5, data-model.md §10): every item of its companion's gap sections and every behaviour of a host's code, each with the part of the description that states it, the host's concern it is, or the reference behaviour it diverges from.

companion.description: The companion file and the sections whose `###` headings and top-level list items are the items.

items.description: One item of the companion.
One behaviour read in a host's code at its reference commit.

Provenance.description: Who produced one part of a fixture (ATD §2.3).

ConformanceStep.description: One gesture of a case and what it must produce (ATD §2.3). Exactly one of `action`, `property`, `move`, `create`, `connect`, `delete`, `undo` and `redo`; `select` before it.

property.description: A property set through a form.

ids.description: The ids the reference host generated in this step, in order, handed to the runtime.

items.description: A finding a reading or a step gives: its rule or code and where.

oneOf.description: A drawing kept in a file beside the fixture.

refused.description: The gesture is refused, with this reason.

ConformanceFixture.description: One conformance case of one tool type (ATD §2.3, data-model.md §8).

inputs.description: The input files of the case by role (`body`, `registration`, …): paths relative to the case's folder, kept byte for byte.

items.description: An element.
A relation.
A finding a reading or a step gives: its rule or code and where.
An unreadable part of the body.

oneOf.description: A drawing kept in a file beside the fixture.

Drawing.description: The scene of one view in `adp-scene`'s vocabulary (ATD §2.4, data-model.md §9). Two drawings are equal when their elements and edges are equal as sets keyed by `id` and their `order` lists are equal.

items.description: A drawn element.

bounds.description: A box in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

items.description: A label as drawn.

position.description: A point in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

style.description: The resolved style: paints as colours, with the token names they came from.

items.description: A drawn edge.
A point in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

style.description: The resolved style: paints as colours, with the token names they came from.

order.description: The ids of elements, edges and chrome in drawing order (z-order).

Capability.description: The contract of a capability (ATD §2.6, §13, data-model.md §7).

input.description: A reference to the `$defs` entry of the input.

output.description: A reference to the `$defs` entry of the output.

items.description: An exception to ATD §12's determinism, stated in the contract (ATD §13.5).

CapabilityFixture.description: One fixture of a capability: an input, the arguments and the expected output (ATD §2.6).

LayoutInput.description: The input of a `layout` capability: the nodes with their sizes and pins, the edges and the containment, in the canvas's domain units.

items.description: A node.

pinned.description: A point in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

items.description: An edge.

LayoutResult.description: The output of a `layout` capability: a position for every node it places, in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01, and optionally route points.

additionalProperties.description: A point in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

items.description: A point in the canvas's domain units, rounded to 0.01.

ReaderInput.description: The input of a `reader` capability: the body's bytes as text, and the edit to plan when one is asked (FBL §11.2).

ReaderResult.description: The output of a `reader` capability: what FBL §11.2's read returns, or the splices of a planned edit.

items.description: A finding a reading or a step gives: its rule or code and where.

RenderInput.description: The input of a `render` capability: a value to render.

RenderResult.description: The output of a `render` capability: text runs or a drawing.

items.description: A run of text with its style.

AnalysisInput.description: The input of an `analysis` or `arrange` capability: a model or part of one.

AnalysisResult.description: The output of an `analysis` capability: derived elements or relations and findings; of an `arrange` capability: actions.

items.description: A finding a reading or a step gives: its rule or code and where.

Walk.description: The 30-edit walk of SC-005 (ATD §19): steps over the examples, each a request at a position or an edit, with its expected result.

items.description: One step.

edit.description: Text replacing a range, in lines and columns.

SettingsSchemas.description: The `$defs` of DISL, DESL and FBL that the settings of ATD's constructs are checked against (ATD §14.6), by reference; each construct's entry is listed in ATD's Appendix A.
